subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should OpenClaw keep a persistent breadcrumb/header surface for active agent plus workspace context, or should this PR's behavior move into the newer no-breadcrumb header/sidebar direction?
rationale: The focused implementation is reasonable, but current main has refactored the files and an open maintainer draft removes the exact breadcrumb component, so automation cannot choose the final Control UI header contract.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Keep the existing breadcrumb idea, port this workspace context onto the current app-host/app-topbar/dashboard-header files, and rerun proof/checks before merge.

options.title: Adopt No-Breadcrumb Direction
options.body: Pause this PR and require the workspace context to be redesigned into the header/sidebar surface proposed by the open draft before landing anything.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Require the PR to cover more of the linked issue, such as switch feedback or live-target proof, rather than merging the focused breadcrumb slice.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep the existing breadcrumb idea, port this workspace context onto the current app-host/app-topbar/dashboard-header files, and rerun proof/checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the active-agent breadcrumb surface that this PR extends, making them the best routed owner for whether that surface should continue.
